snapshot.selection: all namespace-0 pages in the exact current-revision dump; no live-page fetches
snapshot.revision_binding: each emitted record must bind page_id + revision_id + revision_timestamp + revision_sha1 from the XML dump

attribution: retain page title and stable source URL or an equivalent author list
retain exact page revision identity and page history route for contributor attribution
retain license notice and license URL/copy when redistributing
preserve any additional attribution requirements attached to imported text

provenance.platform_role: Wikimedia Foundation hosts infrastructure; community contributors create/edit content
provenance.public_domain_distinction: public-domain contributions may occur, but this audit does not relabel the whole dump as public domain
provenance.imported_text_risk: Wikimedia Terms state imported text can carry compatible CC BY-SA licensing and additional attribution requirements
provenance.required_for_admission: page-level provenance/attribution manifest must fail-close on imported-text notices and must not infer GFDL availability for every record

family_lineage.rule: A different Wikimedia project hostname/database is not sufficient evidence of an independent source family.
required_before_family_credit: compare exact and normalized hashes against admitted/pending Ukrainian Wikipedia and Wikisource objects
inspect internal import/copy attribution and page histories for shared document lineage
collapse mirrors, copied pages, translations sharing the same document lineage, and imported derivatives into one connected family cluster

dedup.within_snapshot: exact normalized duplicate groups measured by the probe

retest_exit_criteria: deterministic namespace-0 probe produces immutable revision-level manifest and quality/language statistics
page-level attribution/provenance audit covers imported-text conditions
cross-Wikimedia lineage/dedup audit is terminal and assigns family identity without URL-based inflation
separate source-registry successor explicitly admits the object for training/redistribution
evaluation remains excluded unless separately authorized
